verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a payments SaaS platform like Flutterwave, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, storage regions, or any region-selection control. Multi-currency and multi-country payment coverage is a different capability and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
